This Spades card game adds strategic depth to the traditional trick-taking format. Play this popular game to relax, challenge your brain, and improve with every hand. Fans of free Spades, Cribbage, and Pinochle will enjoy every match.

But watch out — spade cards only come into play once broken! It’s a game of timing, tactics, and precision. If you enjoy Spades offline, solo or multiplayer, this game has it all.
